chief_complaint: Shortness of breath and persistent cough for the past week.

medications_prescribed.name: Amoxicillin
medications_prescribed.frequency: three times a day for 7 days

medications_prescribed.name: Acetaminophen
medications_prescribed.frequency: as needed for fever or pain

doctor_notes: Patient presents with symptoms suggestive of pneumonia. Chest X-ray ordered and pending. Auscultation reveals crackles in the left lower lobe. Hypertension is noted, and current medication adjusted. Advised on rest, hydration, and signs of worsening condition.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Hello Eleanor, thanks for coming in. Tell me what's been bothering you.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Doctor, I've been feeling so breathless, and this cough just won't go away. It started about a week ago.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: I see. Any fever or chest pain with the cough?

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: A little bit of fever, off and on. No sharp chest pain, just a dull ache sometimes.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Okay, I'm going to examine your chest now. It sounds like you might have a chest infection.

conversation_summary.speaker: Doctor
conversation_summary.text: Your blood pressure is a bit high today, Eleanor. We'll keep an eye on that. I'll prescribe some antibiotics for the infection and adjust your blood pressure medication slightly.

conversation_summary.speaker: Patient
conversation_summary.text: Thank you, Doctor. I just want to feel better.

follow_up_actions: Return to clinic if symptoms worsen or new symptoms arise.
